commit: us: hold near readings for 500 ms so the arm's gate can't miss a passing hand
title: Ultrasonic latches the nearest reading: right until something comes within 25 cm, then it never lets go (the near-object hold keeps itself alive), so the arm flails after the hand is gone

trigger.how: Dormant from boot: distances are right. Hold a hand 5-15 cm in front of the HC-SR04 for about a second, then take it away: the reported distance stays at the hand's until the pod is reset or reflashed. arm/heal_test.py runs it with the arm looping its job.

name: 08-us-near-hold
